CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, email, full_name, system_role, is_active)
    VALUES (
        NEW.id,
        COALESCE(NEW.email, ''),
        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', ''),
        'USER',
        true
    )
    ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_workspace_access(p_workspace_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF p_workspace_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN FALSE;
    END IF;

    RETURN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.workspace_members wm
        JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = wm.user_id
        WHERE wm.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
          AND wm.user_id = auth.uid()
          AND wm.is_active = true
          AND p.is_active = true
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_super_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
        WHERE id = auth.uid()
          AND system_role = 'SUPER_ADMIN'
          AND is_active = true
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_audit_event()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID;
    v_details JSONB;
    v_target_id UUID;
BEGIN
    -- Attempt to get user ID from Supabase auth context
    BEGIN
        v_user_id := auth.uid();
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
        v_user_id := NULL;
    END;

    -- Prepare details and identify target record ID based on operation
    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
        v_details := jsonb_build_object('new', row_to_json(NEW));
        v_target_id := NEW.id;
        
        INSERT INTO audit_logs (
            user_id,
            action,
            module_name,
            entity_type,
            record_id,
            entity_id,
            record_details,
            details
        )
        VALUES (
            v_user_id,
            TG_OP,
            TG_TABLE_NAME,
            TG_TABLE_NAME,
            v_target_id,
            v_target_id,
            v_details,
            v_details
        );
        RETURN NEW;
    ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
        v_details := jsonb_build_object('old', row_to_json(OLD), 'new', row_to_json(NEW));
        v_target_id := NEW.id;
        
        INSERT INTO audit_logs (
            user_id,
            action,
            module_name,
            entity_type,
            record_id,
            entity_id,
            record_details,
            details
        )
        VALUES (
            v_user_id,
            TG_OP,
            TG_TABLE_NAME,
            TG_TABLE_NAME,
            v_target_id,
            v_target_id,
            v_details,
            v_details
        );
        RETURN NEW;
    ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
        v_details := jsonb_build_object('old', row_to_json(OLD));
        v_target_id := OLD.id;
        
        INSERT INTO audit_logs (
            user_id,
            action,
            module_name,
            entity_type,
            record_id,
            entity_id,
            record_details,
            details
        )
        VALUES (
            v_user_id,
            TG_OP,
            TG_TABLE_NAME,
            TG_TABLE_NAME,
            v_target_id,
            v_target_id,
            v_details,
            v_details
        );
        RETURN OLD;
    END IF;
    
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_delivery_workspace_reassignment()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF OLD.workspace_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.workspace_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.workspace_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Workspace immutability violation: workspace_id cannot be modified.'
            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_stock_on_purchase()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
        UPDATE products 
        SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + NEW.quantity_bought 
        WHERE id = NEW.product_id;
    ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
        IF OLD.product_id = NEW.product_id THEN
            -- Same product: adjust stock by net difference
            UPDATE products 
            SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - OLD.quantity_bought + NEW.quantity_bought 
            WHERE id = NEW.product_id;
        ELSE
            -- Product changed: revert stock on old product and apply to new product
            UPDATE products 
            SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - OLD.quantity_bought 
            WHERE id = OLD.product_id;
            
            UPDATE products 
            SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + NEW.quantity_bought 
            WHERE id = NEW.product_id;
        END IF;
    ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
        UPDATE products 
        SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - OLD.quantity_bought 
        WHERE id = OLD.product_id;
    END IF;
    
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$
